description: Make unattended overnight runs survive repeated failures, timed-out agents, EPIPE, worktree races, Ctrl-C, and provider outages

userStories.title: commitProgress skips an unchanged file
userStories.description: As an operator, I want commitProgress to return false instead of throwing when the progress file has not changed since the last commit, so that a ticket failing twice does not crash the run.
acceptanceCriteria: commitProgress returns Promise<boolean> -- true when a commit was made, false when the staged file matched HEAD
A second commitProgress call with identical content resolves false and does not create a commit
No 'nothing to commit' error is thrown
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
userStories.notes: Modify src/progress.ts:186-202. Test in test/progress.test.ts. Use git diff --cached --quiet to detect no-op before committing.

userStories.title: A failed ticket is recorded once and not re-run this run
userStories.description: As an operator, I want a ticket that exhausted its retry attempts to be excluded from later waves of the same run, so that it does not repeat the same failure and crash the orchestrator.
acceptanceCriteria: A per-run failedNums set tracks tickets that used up their attempts
findReadyTickets results are filtered by failedNums in both runWaves and runWavesIsolated
A saveProgress helper wraps writeProgress + commitProgress and catches commit errors
The final summary line includes the failed count when > 0
A ticket that fails in wave 1 is not started again in wave 2
A ticket whose merge failed is still re-run (not excluded)
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
userStories.notes: Modify src/orchestrator.ts (runWaves and runWavesIsolated). Create test/mock-agent-fail-ticket-01.js. Test in test/integration.test.ts. Depends on US-001 for the boolean return from commitProgress.

userStories.title: An agent that exits before reading stdin cannot crash the run
userStories.description: As an operator, I want the orchestrator to survive EPIPE from an agent that exits before reading its prompt, so that auth errors or bad flags do not take the whole run down.
acceptanceCriteria: spawnAgent installs a proc.stdin error listener that logs to the agent log file
An agent that exits immediately with a 2MB prompt does not cause an uncaught EPIPE
spawnAgent resolves with exitCode 1 and timedOut false
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
userStories.notes: Modify src/orchestrator.ts:714-717. Create test/mock-agent-exit-before-reading.js. Test in test/integration.test.ts.

userStories.title: The timeout kill takes the agent's process group and always resolves
userStories.description: As an operator, I want the timeout kill to stop the agent and all its children (dev servers, watchers), and for spawnAgent to always resolve instead of hanging when a grandchild holds the stdout pipe.
acceptanceCriteria: Agents are spawned with detached:true
The timeout sends SIGKILL to the process group (-pid), not just the agent
A killProcessGroup helper is defined for reuse by signal handling
stdout and stderr are destroyed CLOSE_GRACE_MS (2000ms) after exit as a fallback
spawnAgent resolves within a few seconds of the timeout even when a grandchild holds the pipe
The grandchild process is killed
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
userStories.notes: Modify src/orchestrator.ts (spawn call, timeout, promise). Create test/mock-agent-grandchild-hang.js. Test in test/integration.test.ts.

userStories.title: Worktree creation is serialized
userStories.description: As an operator running many tickets in parallel, I want worktree creation to be serialized so that concurrent git operations do not race on shared refs.
acceptanceCriteria: createWorktree calls are queued module-wide via a promise chain
50 concurrent createWorktree calls all succeed (run 5 rounds of 10)
The public signature of createWorktree is unchanged
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
userStories.notes: Modify src/worktree.ts:47-113. Rename existing function to createWorktreeNow, add enqueue wrapper. Test in test/worktree.test.ts.

userStories.title: Ctrl-C and SIGTERM stop the run and kill agents
userStories.description: As an operator, I want Ctrl-C and SIGTERM to kill all running agents and exit cleanly, instead of leaving agents running after the orchestrator is interrupted.
acceptanceCriteria: StatusDisplay no longer installs process signal handlers
A runningAgents registry in the orchestrator tracks spawned agents
killRunningAgents() is exported and kills every tracked agent's process group
The CLI installs SIGINT and SIGTERM handlers that call killRunningAgents, cleanup the display, and exit 130 or 143
Sending SIGINT to the CLI process kills the agent's child processes
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
userStories.notes: Modify src/orchestrator.ts, src/display.ts, src/index.ts. Test in test/display.test.ts and test/integration.test.ts. Depends on killProcessGroup from US-004.

userStories.title: Backoff between retries
userStories.description: As an operator, I want retries to wait with exponential backoff so that a provider outage is waited out instead of burning every attempt at once.
acceptanceCriteria: DEFAULT_RETRY_DELAY is exported as 30
retryDelayFor(base, attempt) returns base * 2^(attempt-2)
retryDelayFor(30, 2) is 30, retryDelayFor(30, 3) is 60, retryDelayFor(0, 3) is 0
runWavesIsolated and runWaves accept a retryDelay option
The CLI has a --retry-delay flag defaulting to DEFAULT_RETRY_DELAY
dryRunIsolated prints the retry delay
Existing CLI tests that exercise retries pass --retry-delay 0 to stay fast
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
userStories.notes: Modify src/orchestrator.ts and src/index.ts. Test in test/orchestrator.test.ts and test/integration.test.ts. Add --retry-delay 0 to existing retry-exercising CLI tests.

userStories.title: A throw inside an attempt fails that attempt, not the wave
userStories.description: As an operator, I want an error inside a ticket attempt (e.g. the agent deleted its own worktree) to fail just that ticket, not crash the entire wave.
acceptanceCriteria: TicketOutcome gains an 'error' kind with an error field
runTicketAttempts wraps each attempt in try/catch and returns the error outcome
The outcome loop in runWavesIsolated handles the error kind by adding to failedNums and continuing
An agent that deletes its own worktree fails its ticket but the other ticket in the wave succeeds
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
userStories.notes: Modify src/orchestrator.ts. Create test/mock-agent-delete-worktree-01.js. Test in test/integration.test.ts. Depends on failedNums from US-002.

userStories.title: The prompt confines the agent to its worktree

acceptanceCriteria: renderPrompt output contains a rule mentioning 'git push'
renderPrompt output contains a rule mentioning 'current directory'
renderMergePrompt output contains a rule mentioning 'git push'
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
userStories.notes: Modify src/orchestrator.ts (renderPrompt rules and renderMergePrompt). Test in test/orchestrator.test.ts.

userStories.title: A failed attempt's worktree is removed even when dirty

removeWorktree passes --force to git when opts.force is true

removeWorktreeQuietly in the orchestrator passes force:true
runWavesIsolated cleans up dirty worktrees after failed agents

userStories.notes: Modify src/worktree.ts and src/orchestrator.ts. Create test/mock-agent-dirty-then-fail.js. Test in test/worktree.test.ts and test/integration.test.ts.
